discription: A soft and evolving pad sound created using two slightly detuned pulse waves with slow pulse width modulation, designed for ambient textures.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, detune=0.001, lfoRate=0.2, pwDepth=0.05; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.5, 1.0, 0.7, 2.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); var lfo = SinOsc.kr(lfoRate, 0, pwDepth, 0.5); var pulse1 = Pulse.ar(freq, lfo); var pulse2 = Pulse.ar(freq * (1 + detune), lfo); sig = (pulse1 + pulse2) * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
